prayerExcerpt.en-US: I am the wheat of Christ to be ground by the teeth of beasts, that I may be found to be pure bread.
prayerExcerpt.pt-BR: Eu sou trigo de Cristo, serei moído pelos dentes das feras, para tornar-me um pão sem mistura.

meta.face: An old man of about seventy, bald on the crown with a fringe of grey hair, a long grey beard narrowing to a point, a lean ascetic face, a steady upward gaze. The beard is grey and tapering, not broad and white.
meta.basis: The Painter's Manual (an old man with a broad beard) and the Hosios Loukas mosaic, kept grey and tapering to stay apart from the white-bearded elders; the lions from his martyrdom. The excerpt is his memorial's communion antiphon, from his Letter to the Romans.

sources.title: Wikipedia, Ignatius of Antioch (Hosios Loukas mosaic)
Didron, Manuel d'iconographie chrétienne (Dionysius of Fourna)
